verses.1: And when he opened the seven-day seal, a silence filled the sky, like a moment of peace.
verses.2: And we saw the seven angels who stood before the Lord. They were given seven trumpets.
verses.3: Another angel also came and stood at the altar, carrying a golden rod. He was given many gifts to use in the prayers of all the saints, so that they could offer those gifts to the altar with the golden rod placed in front of the throne.
verses.4: And the smoke of the sacrifices rose up during the prayers of the saints, from the hands of the angel before the Lord.
verses.5: And the angel took the lamb from the altar, and threw it into the fire of the sacrifice. Then there were thunder, lightnings, voices, and earthquakes.
verses.6: And the seven angels who held the seven trumpets prepared themselves to blow them.
verses.7: And the first one became destroyed. Then, chaos and fire spread everywhere in the blood. The third part of the earth was destroyed, and so was a third of the trees. Every fertile land was destroyed as well.
verses.8: And the second messenger caused a great fire to break out; and it seemed as if a mountain of fire was being thrown into the sea. And then, the third “blood” of the sea occurred.
verses.9: And the third of the ships that were in the sea also died. The souls of those who were on those ships also perished. And the third of the ships was destroyed.
verses.10: And the third angel also cried out loudly. A huge flame fell from heaven, shining like light. It fell upon the third river and upon the sources of water.
verses.11: And the name of that star is said to be Apsinthos. It became the third of the waters to turn into Apsinthos. Many people died from drinking those waters, because they were too concentrated.
verses.12: And the fourth messenger also caused chaos. The third day of the month was ruined; the third part of the night was also ruined, and the third part of the stars was also ruined. As a result, the third part of everything became dark, and the day didn’t have its third part at all. The same happened with the night.
verses.13: And I saw, and I heard one bird singing in the middle of the meadow, with a loud voice. The inhabitants of the land were filled with joy when they heard the sound of that bird’s song. It was like the sound of three angels singing together.
